profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Having graduated from MIT with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence and Decision Making, I am now pursuing my career as a software engineer at Microsoft. I am passionate about the intersection between AI, data science, and software engineering, and leveraging them to create globally impactful solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developing quality and servicing solutions in the Azure Host Networking team.

positions.title: Market Operations Intern
positions.description:
Forecasting regulation service deployments in the ERCOT power market using machine learning models in the Market Operations team

- Performed exploratory data analysis and constructed many data visualizations to analyze the power market's time series in Jupyter Notebooks

- Explored 8 different machine learning and traditional statistical methods for time series forecasting, then implemented the LSTM and XGBoost models

- Created an evaluation framework to compare the incumbent naive model and XGBoost models

- Integrated the final XGBoost model that predicts out 30 minutes into production with a corresponding test framework and robustness to different prediction times and inputs

- Resulted in a 58% reduction in error over the incumbent naive model for the first 5 minutes and an average of 17% reduction in error for the next 25 minutes
positions.insights: Skills: Time Series Forecasting · Machine Learning · Software Development · Python · Statistical Data Analysis · Pandas (Software) · Data Visualization · Git · GitHub

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Automating Regression Detection, Triage and Redeployment of Performance Monitoring VMs on the Azure Compute team

- Deployed an automated system to periodically monitor virtual machine (VM) performance metrics and identify and report any incidents using the Kusto Query Language (KQL), and Microsoft Power Automate.

- Employed database query optimization techniques for an order of magnitude improvement in speed.

- Produced an algorithm that detects three types of regressions based on statistics.

- Developed another algorithm that detects whenever a metric regresses and then improves using convolution.

- Built a pipeline for automated redeployment of regressed or missing VMs using PowerShell, YAML, and KQL.

- Detects faulty VMs with missing or regressed data 19 hours quicker and saves up to 2 developer hours per incident on critical VM identification, automated triage, and redeployment.
positions.insights: Skills: Kusto Query Language (KQL) · Microsoft Power Automate · Microsoft Azure · Powershell · YAML · Azure DevOps

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
Deep learning-based computer vision for Pakistan real estate tax collection

- Created a computer vision system to identify real estate features for accurate tax collection in Pakistan.

- Employed transfer learning on state-of-the-art models (ResNet and ConvNeXT) using PyTorch and
TensorFlow in Python and Jupyter Notebooks, increasing performance by more than 10%.

- Constructed ensemble models that seamlessly combine multiple DNN architectures (ResNet-18, ResNet-34, ConvNeXT), which were then deployed on an app for the partner tax collectors to use in the field in Pakistan.

- Vastly improved the existing deep learning systems with class balancing, sampling, data cleaning, and feature engineering with Pandas and Scikit-learn.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Vision · Deep Learning · Machine Learning · PyTorch · Jupyter

positions.title: STEP Intern
positions.locationName: Mountain View, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Developed a Machine Learning-based noise detection solution using derived statistical features.

- The project has the potential to save ~1400 device-hours per month, a 2.8% resource usage improvement.

- Composed an in-depth, 13-page software design that also compared 16 different models.

- Built an End-to-End ML system with Python and SQL to predict if performance regression detection parameters are properly set for a metric.

- Trained multiple classification models with an internal AutoML framework using TensorFlow - including Random Forest, Decision Tree, and Neural Network models - and employed different training strategies.

- Invented two original algorithms that validates and refines model output, eliminating 60% of noisy predictions.

- Executed the full MLOps practice, from scoping to model deployment, in iterations.

- Collaborated with another intern, who integrated the input and output of the ML system into the existing infra.
positions.insights: Skills: Applied Machine Learning · SQL · Python · MLOps · Machine Learning · Software Development · Automated Machine Learning (AutoML)

honors.title: HSF Scholar - Youth Leadership Institute 2020
honors.description: I was selected to be one of the 400 accepted scholars out of about 5,000 applicants for the Hispanic Scholarship Fund's Youth Leadership Institute (YLI). I obtained a plethora of information about the college application process, how to succeed in college, how to succeed in my career, and how to be a leader for others.
honors.issuer: Issued by Hispanic Scholarship Fund · Jul 2020
